allow: PowerShell(Stop-Process -Id 10368 -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Start-Sleep -Milliseconds 500; $still = Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen -LocalPort 3000 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if \($still\) { Write-Output "Port 3000 STILL bound \(PID $\($still.OwningProcess\)\)" } else { Write-Output "Port 3000 free" })
